name: Miso Tuna Salad Cucumber Bites with Chives & Sesame Seeds
ingredients: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water
instructions: Place mayo, miso paste, vinegar, sugar, garlic powder, and pepper in a medium bowl. Stir to combine the dressing and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Drain tuna, add to the bowl, and flake with a fork. Stir to combine the tuna salad and set aside.
Trim and slice cucumber crosswise into ½-inch thick rounds. Chop chives into small pieces.
To serve, divide cucumber slices between plates. Top each slice with a spoonful of tuna salad, then sprinkle with chives and sesame seeds. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
